Can Brexit Be Reversed?

Hugo Drochon

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has called Brexit a mistake, and opinion polls show that his proposal to "go all the way" and rejoin the European Union has majority support. But Brexit was won by a movement, and only a movement can reverse it.

Ian Forsyth/Getty Images

Nov 16, 2026
5 min read

NOTTINGHAM—At the UK Labour Party’s conference in Liverpool in late September, Prime Minister Andy Burnham went where no British prime minister had dared since the United Kingdom left the European Union: “Brexit has done more harm than good” he told the delegates. The next day, he went further: Britain could stay as it is, join the customs union or the single market, or “go all the way.” And now he says he wants an “honest discussion” about freedom of movement.
